info.title: Campus Equipment Borrowing Lab 5 API
info.description: JSON UTF-8. Asia/Manila calendar dates. Unknown routes 404 and wrong methods 405 with Error body. Lists include related display records. Search is trimmed case-insensitive partial text; ID breaks date ties. Protected/unknown body fields and unsupported/repeated query parameters are rejected. Checkout is atomic. No automatic mutation retry; outcome_unknown requires refresh and inspection. Positive IDs are opaque stable identifiers.
